---
title: Accessibility pass: sheet focus trap, timer announcements, contrast
labels: ui,accessibility
---

From the review rounds, still open:
- [ ] "What to show" sheet: trap focus inside while open; return focus to the Showing button on close (partly done).
- [ ] Timer: announce only key moments to screen readers ("Rest done", "Goal reached", "Side 2"), not every second.
- [ ] Sound toggle for the beep (some people train with others asleep).
- [ ] Check contrast of muted text and pills in dark mode (WCAG AA).
- [ ] All tap targets ≥ 44px (some History/ladder buttons are 36–40px).
- [ ] Respect reduced motion for any scroll/animation.
